aiGuides.title: Fixing a Wobbly Folding Desk Chair
aiGuides.summary: It looks like your folding desk chair has loose joints or screws along the frame and writing arm. Over time, regular opening, closing, and leaning on the desk pad can loosen the hardware that holds it stable.
safetyNotes: Keep your fingers clear of metal hinges so they do not get pinched while working.
Work on a flat floor so the chair does not tip over.
steps: 🔍 Check all the screws and bolts under the seat pad, desk attachment, and leg joints to see which ones feel loose.
🪛 Tighten the screws holding the wooden writing desk to its metal arm using a screwdriver.
🔧 Use your wrench to gently tighten the bolts at the folding pivot points. | tip: do not overtighten or the chair will be hard to fold
🧼 Wipe down the joints with a clean cloth to clear away dust and grime.
🪑 Carefully open and close the chair to make sure everything folds smoothly and feels sturdy.
